newsitem.title: UK: PolyMASC says wins challenge to key patent.
newsitem.headline: PolyMASC says wins challenge to key patent.

text.p: Biotechnology company PolyMASc Pharmaceuticals Plc said on Monday that it had defeated a challenge to one of its key technology patents.

PolyMASC, which is listed on the Alternative Investment Market (AIM), said in a statement that a patent on using Polyethylene Glycol polymers and liposomes to combat diseases including cancer now had "full validity" in most western European countries, including France, Britain and Spain.
Shares in PolyMASC rose 5p to 118-1/2 in early afternoon trading.
PolyMASC said that an appeal against a European Patent Office ruling by the U.S. group Sequus Pharmaceuticals Inc had failed.

Sequus had originally claimed rights to invention and ownership of the technology, which involves attaching polymers to the fatty bubbles known as liposomes in order to gain access to individual cells. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
